narration: In month {fork_month}, when HR came with an offer on top of the company's policy, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month {first_bar_apart_month}, with a little more of the ghost's pay committed before each month began. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {end_month}, as far apart as the two lives ever stood, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's cushion against a stretch without pay ended {safety_gap}. Its days read as living, not just getting by, by a hair, and came out {life_gap}.
